name: Himei -Chikashitsu ni Torawareta 11 Nin-
original_name: 悲鳴 -地下室に囚われた１１人-
source:
The setting is a training camp in a certain mountain village. In this place rich in nature, an unprecedented tragedy begins to unfold...

The story begins when an escaped robber and murderer takes over a training camp surrounded by the sea and mountains. Eleven basketball players, who just happened to be using the camp, find themselves confined in the building. The criminals, treating it like a game, start preying on the girls they've trapped in the basement. Amidst this despair, with no end in sight, what will become of their fate..?

[Translated from the [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
背景是某个山村的训练营。在这个大自然丰富的地方，一场史无前例的悲剧开始上演……

故事开始于一名逃亡的强盗和杀人犯占领了一个依山傍海的训练营。十一名篮球运动员恰好在使用该营地，却发现自己被困在大楼里。犯罪分子把这当作一场游戏，开始掠夺被困在地下室的女孩们。在这看不到尽头的绝望之中，他们的命运将会如何……？
